description: This Dart file implements a Flutter login screen supporting password and OTP login modes, including password reset functionality. It manages user input, validation, API calls, and UI state transitions.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a login interface supporting password and OTP authentication modes, along with password reset features.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen managing UI state, user input controllers, API interactions, and login flow logic.

methods.name: _loginWithPassword
methods.description: Handles login using password, manages lockout after failed attempts, updates UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for phone number verification, updates UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndLogin
methods.description: Verifies OTP and logs in if valid, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: _passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by requesting a reset OTP.

methods.name: _passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and new password, resets failed attempts counter on success.
